name: Sum of Digits of Sums
description: You are given an array $$$[a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n]$$$, consisting of positive integers. For every $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, calculate $$$\sum \limits_{j=1}^{n} F(a_i + a_j)$$$, where $$$F(x)$$$ is the sum of digits of $$$x$$$.
input_specification: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$). The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \lt 10^9$$$).
output_specification: Print $$$n$$$ integers. The $$$i$$$-th of them should be equal to $$$\sum \limits_{j=1}^{n} F(a_i + a_j)$$$.
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
